root.data_with_special_chars: This contains <special> characters like & and < that would normally need escaping
root.xquery_update_facility:
<!-- Example XQuery Update expressions for modifying XML content -->
let $doc := doc("example.xml")
return (
    insert nodes <new-element>content</new-element> into $doc/root,
    delete nodes $doc/root/old-element,
    replace value of node $doc/root/target-element with "updated content"
)
